refnamediv.refpurpose: Enumeration representing the status of a SilikoNode

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodeStatus enumeration represents whether a syntax tree node is a branch, leaf, or a simple placeholder.

listitem.para: SilikoNodeNothing: The node was generated by a parser to indicate that a rule was not able to process further input, but is not in an error condition. This may be used, for example, to indicate that the end of a list has been reached by a function that does not process the end of list indicator or the next operator being processed.
SilikoNodeBranch: The node is a branch. A branch node will have a function identifier, and an array of child SilikoNode objects.
SilikoNodeLeaf The node is a leaf. The node has no child nodes, and is either a value or an error.
